title: The Tropical Island
seo_title: Tropical Island Charcuterie Board: Pineapple Palms & Plan
description: A tropical island charcuterie board for 12 to 15: pineapple palm trees over a lagoon of shrimp and mango salsa, with teriyaki skewers and prosciutto melon.
hook: Two pineapple palm trees tower over a turquoise lagoon filled with shrimp and mango salsa, ringed by a toasted-coconut beach.
why: Each palm tree is a pineapple, cut and rebuilt so it stands up with its leafy top. They give the board height, which is what makes it look dramatic from across the room.

The food is a luau: teriyaki chicken skewers, chilled shrimp, prosciutto-wrapped melon, mango salsa, papaya and pepper jack and Havarti cubes. It's made for summer birthdays, pool parties and luau themes.

timeline.what: Marinate the chicken. Make the mango salsa. Toast the coconut.
Grill or bake the chicken skewers.
Set the lagoon and the beach, then the fruit and the rest of the feast.

faq.q: How do you make pineapple palm trees?
faq.a: Each palm is a whole pineapple, cut and rebuilt on a long skewer so it stands tall with its leafy crown on top. The book walks through the cuts step by step.
Only the teriyaki chicken skewers. Everything else is ready to eat.

Cook the skewers and make the salsa the day before. Keep the shrimp on ice until serving. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
